body.name: Murderbot
body.overview: In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet... even though it just wants to binge soap operas.
body.tagline: Built to destroy. Forced to connect.
